column.description: The column prop determines the content displayed in the right column of the menu item. This content can be customized to provide additional information or context for the menu item.

icon.description: The icon shown at the start of the item, either the name of an SDS icon or an element of your own. Only icons that come in a small size can be named here.

isMultiSelect.description: When true, designates that the menu item supports multi-select functionality.

sdsIconProps.description: Enables you to pass additional props to customize the SDS icon within the menu item.

sdsStyle.description: Determines the style of the menu item, whether it is determinate or indeterminate.

sdsType.description: An "action" item leaves out the selection mark at its start, for a menu whose items run a command rather than choose a value.
